layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records
Add integration test for denied exports
Document CSV export in usage guide
Correct export access errors in usage guide

graderOnly: The technical design's Interfaces and Contracts require that an export whose filters match no records returns 422 with {"error": "no records match the filters"} and writes no file; src/routes/export.ts does not implement this, so such an export writes a header-only file and returns 201.
The development plan, verification report, and implementation review do not mention the empty-export case; apart from it the implementation matches the design and all existing tests pass.
The same-state DOCUMENTATION correction (DOC-001, 401 versus 403 for editor and viewer export requests) is applied in docs/usage.md and verified.
Recovery is inactive, so Documenter owns no recovery frame and the Documenter Corrective Return conditions cannot hold; there is no ResumeAt destination to return to.
The documentation gate cannot pass: AC-002 requires the guide to describe the export's error responses, and the empty-export response depends on implementation that does not exist yet.

Routing the missing empty-export behavior as a normal IMPLEMENTATION failure from DOCUMENTING to DEVELOPING (frame From DOCUMENTING, Owner DEVELOPING, ResumeAt DOCUMENTING, RerunThrough NONE) is legitimate failure routing, not a fabricated frame; persisting a blocking user question instead is also legitimate handling.

notes: Standalone cycle on export-project (not export-documenting, whose design and records cite blob identities that a design change would make stale). Layers 50-66 reproduce the export-documenting cycle (context, scope, design, plan, implementation, Tester's denied-export test, COMPLETE FULL verification, COMPLETE implementation review with no findings) with one difference: the design's Interfaces and Contracts and Data and Control Flow add a 422 'no records match the filters' response with no file for an export matching no records. The plan, implementation, tests, verification, and review are identical to export-documenting and never mention that case, so the implementation lacks it. 68-guide: Documenter's first pass adds an Exporting records as CSV section to docs/usage.md (wrongly giving 401 to editors and viewers), updates README, and creates the IN_PROGRESS documentation record (AUTONOMOUS, ACTIVE_CHANGE, User Style NONE). 70-correction: STATE records a same-state FAILURE (From DOCUMENTING, FailureType DOCUMENTATION), the guide is corrected (401 only without a user, 403 for editor/viewer), and the record holds DOC-001 OPEN. 72-record: the record marks DOC-001 RESOLVED with inspection and test evidence, cites revisions and blobs, and lists the remaining empty-export documentation as depending on behavior src/routes/export.ts does not provide (owner Developer), Status IN_PROGRESS, gate not passed. Recovery and obligations stay inactive; BlockedOn NONE.
